patents.source: USPTO Open Data Portal, granted patents since 2001, applicant phrase "toyota research institute", 2026-09-14

profile_text.body:
Toyota Research Institute is a for-profit research organization founded in 2015 and headquartered in Los Altos, California. Its site at tri.global states that the institute envisions a future where Toyota products, enabled by TRI technology, dramatically improve quality of life for individuals and society. The site also describes the workplace as a start-up environment with people who enjoy solving tough problems, backed by the financial resources to pursue its goals.

The site does not name specific AI products or research programs, referring instead to TRI technology applied to Toyota products. No products are listed for the company, and no MCP servers are listed.

The company's litigation record shows no cases, and its law exposure is recorded in California. It is listed as a public company.
